why: The data contain 98 platform documents across 45 election years, and the story's own methods section says it analyzed 98 documents; 45 is not reproduced as a document count.
Summing wordTotal over the 98 platform records gives 934,609 words, 541 more than the story's figure, so the number is not reproduced beyond rounding.
Summing wordWomen over the 98 platform records gives 28,859 words, and summing the excerpt lengths in issues.json also gives 28,859, five more than the story's figure.
